What is HMPV?

HMPV (Human Metapneumovirus) is a respiratory virus that causes infections, particularly in children, older adults, and immunocompromised individuals, often resembling cold or flu-like symptoms.

Protect yourself with good hygiene and early detection! https://t.co/AtVTsHLOiE
